assumptions.kernel_invocations: A3 user-reported device Vector 2-3us (midpoint 2.5), Cube about 5us; completion minimum, independent of host launch
assumptions.memory_path: aggregate memory service; internal copy engines require explicit rates
assumptions.profile: registered SKU geometry and nominal rates
assumptions.vector_issue: one FP32 lane operation per cycle unless explicitly overridden

limitations: semantic projection/pool/norm/rope work remains an unfused five-phase reference
state-cache writeback is a native side effect not explicitly represented by the current compressor resource ledger
native internal tensor reuse and workspace traffic are not reconstructed
preserve_workspaces does not supply missing state-write work and therefore cannot justify a complete one-launch program
reserved output capacity is not evidence of completed compression groups
historical A3 capture runtime identity is not established by selecting an independently available source revision

comparison_selection.reason: Every mapper cohort is priced; raw events without a valid cohort remain unscored.
